## Database Studio SaaS Roadmap – Detailed Version

### Introduction

Most database clients today (like DBeaver, TablePlus, or pgAdmin) are desktop-heavy tools. A modern in-browser database studio can stand out by being lightweight, collaborative, and accessible anywhere. Built with Hono.js as the backend, this SaaS will let developers and teams manage their databases directly f

The following roadmap is structured in phases to move from a minimal viable product (MVP) toward a fully-featured SaaS platform that can compete with traditional desktop DB tools while adding unique cloud-first capabilities.

### Phase 1: MVP – Core Developer Tool

Goal

Browser-based database viewer with basic CRUD, inline editing, and query execution.

Entities

Connection: id, name, type (postgres|sqlite|libsql), url/filePath, token, isFavorite

Table: name, schema, columns (name, type, PK, FK)

RowData: rowId, columnValues

QueryHistory: optional, simple array of executed queries

Endpoints

POST /connections → create connection

GET /connections → list connections

PUT /connections/:id → update connection

DELETE /connections/:id → delete connection

POST /connections/:id/connect → test/open connection

GET /connections/:id/tables → list tables + schema

GET /connections/:id/tables/:table/rows?limit=100&offset=0&q=&sort= → fetch rows

PUT /connections/:id/tables/:table/rows/:rowId → inline cell edit

POST /connections/:id/query → raw query executor

GET /connections/:id/metrics → table counts, row counts, DB size

Frontend

Sidebar with connection list

Double-click opens DB studio

Table view: spreadsheet-like with sorting, search, pagination

Cell inline edit with blur-save

Query editor: dry-run + execute

### Phase 2: Multi-User & Security Layer

Goal

Enable workspaces, sharing, and secure access.

Entities

Workspace: id, name, members (userIds + roles)

User: id, email, name, hashedPassword, role

AuditLog: connectionId, action, userId, timestamp

Endpoints

POST /workspaces → create workspace

GET /workspaces/:id/connections → shared connections list

PATCH /connections/:id/favorite → toggle favorite

POST /connections/:id/test → secure test connection

Audit logs automatically recorded for row edits and queries

Features

Role-based permissions: viewer, editor, admin

Encryption for stored credentials

Shared query history & saved queries

Undo / rollback inline edits

### Phase 3: Analytics & Dashboards

Goal

Visual insights, metrics, and user-friendly dashboards.

Entities

Dashboard: id, name, widgets

Widget: type (table/chart), queryId, options (sort, filters)

QueryStats: execution time, rowCount, errors

Endpoints

GET /dashboards/:workspaceId → list dashboards

POST /dashboards/:workspaceId → create dashboard

PUT /dashboards/:id → edit dashboard

DELETE /dashboards/:id → delete dashboard

GET /connections/:id/query-stats → historical query performance

Features

Chart types: bar, line, pie, heatmap

Table visualizations: value distributions, top-N, null %

Metrics: connection latency, query execution, table growth

Alerts: thresholds on row count, query time, errors

### Phase 4: Differentiators / Advanced SaaS Features

Goal

Stand out vs. DBeaver, Drizzle Studio, Supabase Studio.

Entities

ERDiagram: schema + relations

SchemaVersion: snapshots for diff

AIQuerySuggestion: generated SQL / optimization hints

Endpoints

POST /connections/:id/ai-query → natural language → SQL

GET /connections/:id/schema-diff → compare schema versions

POST /connections/:id/offline-sync → sync local edits to cloud

Features

AI-assisted query generation and optimization

Offline-first editing for SQLite/LibSQL

Sync changes to cloud once online

Saved dashboards & charts shareable with links

Integration: export CSV/JSON, webhooks, Slack, Google Sheets

### Suggested Frontend Stack

State: Zustand or Jotai for connections, open tables, dashboards

Tables: @tanstack/react-table for spreadsheet-like view

Editor: Monaco Editor or CodeMirror for SQL

UI: Tailwind + shadcn/ui components

Networking: Fetch or Axios → Hono backend

### Suggested Backend Stack

Framework: Hono.js

Clients: pg (Postgres), better-sqlite3 (SQLite), @libsql/client (Turso/LibSQL)

Validation: zod

Security: encryption for credentials, optional JWT auth for SaaS users

Persistence: SQLite/Postgres for app metadata (connections, users, dashboards)

### Development Phases

Phase 1: MVP – basic connections, CRUD, inline editing, query runner.

Phase 2: Multi-user, roles, workspaces, audit logs, secure credentials.

Phase 3: Analytics, dashboards, metrics, alerts.

Phase 4: AI suggestions, schema diff/ERD, offline sync, integrations, sharing.
